identity.name: OpenAlex
identity.description: Open catalogue of the global research system (works, authors, sources, institutions, topics) with a keyless JSON API; ingests Crossref, PubMed, repositories and Unpaywall OA locations.

asserted.rationale: Broadest open index of scholarly works and the best free discovery surface for building-science and energy-policy literature. It is a pointer layer: records are machine-assembled from Crossref, PubMed, repositories and publisher sites, with ML-assigned topics, so it settles where a work is and what cites it, never what the work says. Tier 2 as a discovery index; the article of record is the publisher's.

jurisdiction.notes: Global literature; the pilot filters to US single-family housing at query time.

artifacts.notes: Work records: DOI, title, authorships, primary_location, best_oa_location, open_access.oa_status, referenced_works, cited_by_count, abstract_inverted_index, topics.

content.notes: Full text is never served here; primary_location / best_oa_location point at the publisher or repository copy.

auth.notes: Keyless calls work for filters/lookups within the anonymous credit budget; anonymous search is throttled. OpenAlex's free API key (query param api_key) lifts that: the key is optional (required: false), so the reference CLI sends it when openalex_api_key resolves and fetches keyless otherwise, redacting it from every record (spec/03.2). The mailto contact rides in the User-Agent (registry user_agent_contact). Never put a literal key or mailto in params.

limits.notes: Observed 2026-09-27 (response headers, anonymous): usage is metered in credits — X-RateLimit-Limit 1000 credits/day (X-RateLimit-Limit-USD 0.1), a DOI filter call cost 1 credit (USD 0.0001), reset daily. Search calls cost more and anonymous search was refused with 429 ('search cluster under elevated load', Retry-After ~30 s). daily_budget 1000 is a request ceiling that can only over-count headroom for search; a free API key raises the budget. 10 req/s is the provider's documented ceiling; the 1 s delay is our choice.

endpoints.name: works-search
endpoints.description: Full-text-index search over works (title, abstract, fulltext n-grams) with optional filters; cursor-paged.

params.name: search
params.description: Relevance search over title/abstract/fulltext. Omit to page a pure filter.

params.name: filter
params.description: Comma-joined filters, e.g. title.search:X, publication_year:2015-2026, is_oa:true, type:article, topics.id:Tnnnn, doi:10.x/y|10.x/z.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor paging: pass * on the first request; the CLI then follows meta.next_cursor. Without it only page 1 is reachable.

params.name: select
params.description: Comma list of top-level fields to return (keeps payloads small).

pagination.notes: Start with cursor=*; next_cursor is null on the last page. Basic page= paging stops at 10,000 results.

response.notes: meta.count is the total hit count; group_by responses use group_by[] instead of results.

endpoints.name: works-by-doi
endpoints.description: Look up one or many works by DOI (up to 50 DOIs OR-joined with |) through the doi filter.

params.name: doi
params.description: Bare DOI (10.x/y), or several joined with |. The CLI URL-encodes it; the filter value is decoded server-side.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Set to the number of DOIs when batching (max 200, but keep DOI batches at 50).

response.notes: Zero results means OpenAlex does not know that DOI (not that the DOI is invalid).

best_for: First-pass discovery of peer-reviewed and grey literature on the pilot topic (panel/service-capacity barriers to heat pump, HPWH and induction retrofits in existing US single-family homes)
Batch DOI -> OA status and best_oa_location before spending keyed or institutional access
De-duplicating a candidate list by DOI / OpenAlex id

query_shapes.recipe: search= plain words; add filter=publication_year:2015-2026,type:article to cut noise; select= the fields you need; cursor=* to page. Fetched successfully 2026-09-27 (fch-38746ae65fef).
query_shapes.example: --param search='electrical panel capacity heat pump' --param per_page=5 --param select=id,doi,title,publication_year,best_oa_location

query_shapes.recipe: Omit search; use filter=title.search:<words> (AND of words in the title). Good for 'panel upgrade', 'service upgrade', '100 amp'. Counts as a search call (throttled anonymously; 429 when tried 2026-09-27).

Find a relevant topic id from a seed paper's topics[] (T-number; e.g. the Energy Policy panel-capacity survey W4411331675 carries T10603 Smart Grid Energy Management), then filter=topics.id:Tnnnn with search= for the specific angle. Concepts (concepts.id / C-numbers) are the deprecated predecessor of topics; prefer topics.
doi=10.x/y (or up to 50 joined with |); read open_access.oa_status and best_oa_location.pdf_url.
filter=cites:W<openalex id> lists works citing a seed paper.

pitfalls: Anonymous search is throttled: on 2026-09-27 anonymous search calls (search= and filter=title.search:) got 429 three times out of four ('Anonymous search is temporarily rate-limited while the search cluster is under elevated load', Retry-After ~30 s), while DOI-filter lookups succeeded. On 429 honour Retry-After once, never loop; fall back to Crossref works-query, or get a free API key (openalex_api_key) — the real fix for deep-research.

Cost: an anonymous search cost USD 0.001 (10 credits) and a DOI filter USD 0.0001 (1 credit) against a USD 0.10 (1,000 credit) daily allowance, i.e. roughly 100 searches a day keyless. Always send select= (5 unselected records were 118 KB).
OpenAlex is a pointer layer: cite the publisher's version of record (resolve the DOI), never the OpenAlex record.
Abstracts come as abstract_inverted_index (word -> positions), not text; rebuilding one is fine for triage but it is not quotable — quote from the fetched article bytes (UPC gate).

search= is executed as fulltext.search and is noisy for technical phrases: 'electrical panel capacity heat pump' returned 57,350 hits led by PV/thermal 'panel' papers, and missed the on-topic Energy Policy panel-capacity survey (10.1016/j.enpol.2025.114712). Use title.search, quoted phrases, or seed-paper citation chasing for precision.
Without cursor=* only page 1 is returned (the CLI follows meta.next_cursor only when a cursor was sent).
ML-assigned topics and author disambiguation are imperfect; do not treat topics as a subject classification of record.
Filter values with commas or colons must stay inside one filter= parameter; separate filters with commas, alternatives with |.
guidance.llm_notes: Default discovery source for deep-research. Record the exact request URL and the fetch sidecar sha256 when a result set seeds a corpus, so the corpus can show how each candidate was found.

resolution.notes: Resolve doi (https://doi.org/<doi>) to the publisher landing page for the version of record; use best_oa_location only as a lawful copy to read, recording its version (publishedVersion / acceptedVersion / submittedVersion) and licence.

lifecycle.cadence_notes: Snapshot data refreshed continuously; entity schema changes are announced on the OpenAlex blog/changelog.

relations.notes: OpenAlex ingests every Crossref DOI record.

discovery.discovered_via: model knowledge (Hermes scholarly registry pass), cross-checked against pdf-harvest references

optional_credentials.notes: Free key from openalex.org; lifts the anonymous search throttle and credit budget. Now declared in access[0].auth as an optional credential, which the reference CLI sends when it resolves (2026-09-27).
Polite-pool contact eorwyn@ucdavis.edu (Ellie, 2026-09-27). Sent in the User-Agent; the CLI injects only one credential per method, and that slot is the API key.

officiality.basis: Machine-assembled index of works published elsewhere.

completeness.notes: Claims ~250M+ works, ingesting all Crossref DOIs plus PubMed and repositories; coverage of grey literature (utility, lab and consultancy reports) is uneven.
